items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I had a picture when I was playing with Senator Desby

ctx.x: No. In those days they didn't get the publicity. No radio or television like they would have now to put a group over.
I had a picture when I was playing with Senator Desby, I can't find. That's what I was looking for.
Well, someday maybe we'll come across it and then we can make copies of some of those things, too. It's nice, that WPA group is nice.
